thread:
jamie: quick sync — posted the Rewind slideout mock in Figma. it shows the compact timeline on the left and a slideout with details + an Emergency Undo CTA on the right. want microcopy + a11y checks before dev handoff. link: https://figma.redwood/replay/123 kiran: saw it, nice. question: should the Undo CTA say 'Emergency undo' or 'Rollback to previous'? maria: prefer 'Rollback to previous'. 'Emergency' feels alarmist and could trigger accidental clicks. also can we make the CTA a destructive style (red) but with an extra confirmation step? taylor: +1 to 'Rollback to previous'. For confirmation, suggest a two-step: toast + type-to-confirm for prod rollbacks. For canaries we can do a lighter confirm. nina: accessibility note — when the slideout opens, screen readers need a clear announcement and focus trap. currently the mock just slides in. we should set focus to the slideout heading and use aria-live for status updates (like rollback in progress). jamie: good calls. copy options i've been testing in the mock: - 'Rollback to previous release' - 'Rollback to last stable' - 'Undo deployment' what do folks prefer? maria: 'Rollback to previous release' is explicit and safe. 'Undo deployment' is ambiguous if there were multiple deploys. kiran: agree on 'Rollback to previous release'. Also on the button label, maybe secondary text below: 'This restores the last successful version. All traffic will switch immediately.' small + subtle. taylor: copy nit: 'switch immediately' -> 'switch instantly' reads better? both fine. also add a link to audit log in the slideout footer: 'View audit trail'. nina: aria/keyboard notes: - when slideout opens: `role=\"dialog\" aria-labelledby=\"slideout-title\" aria-modal=\"true\"` - focus: `document.getElementById('slideout-title').focus()` - announce load: `
Slideout opened: Deployment history
` would also like to avoid auto-playing any animations that steal focus. jamie: thanks, nina — can you paste a short snippet we can hand to eng? nina: sure, lightweight example: ```html

Deployment history

Opened deployment history for Service X. Use arrow keys to navigate versions.
``` kiran: perfect. dev question: the compact timeline on the left — do we keep the inline diff peek or open a dedicated diff panel? inline peek reduces clicks but can be noisy. maria: inline peek works if we limit height and show a 1-line summary + 'view full diff' link. large diffs should offload to a modal/panel. taylor: design pattern idea: hover/focus on a version row expands a condensed diff; keyboard users can press Enter to toggle. ensure the expand/collapse state is announced with `aria-expanded` on the row button. jamie: noted. also need color contrast check on the timeline pills — some shades are barely meeting AA at small sizes. I'll push a darker variant. nina: yes please — for small pill text use min contrast 4.5:1. if the pill is smaller than 18px, fallback to bold + darker bg. maria: microcopy for the tiny timestamp tooltip: 'Deployed by @username — 3h ago — 2% canary -> 100%'. keep it short. kiran: can we surface rollout policy quick actions in the slideout header? e.g., 'Pause', 'Increase to 50%', 'Abort'. maybe as a segmented control. jamie: love it. UX concern: too many actions near the top could make the emergency rollback easier to misclick. propose grouping primary actions under a kebab menu except the most common (Pause). taylor: accessibility again: ensure Pause/Abort are reachable via keyboard and have descriptive aria-labels like `aria-label=\"Pause rollout for Service X\"`. maria: testing plan for handoff: 1) copy finalization + a11y snippets in Figma notes 2) small prototype in storybook for focus/order checks 3) dev implements with unit tests for aria attributes + e2e for rollback flow jamie: timeline — can we finalize copy + a11y snippets by EOD tomorrow? engineering wants to start on the slideout next week. kiran: I can consolidate copy suggestions and push a final frame by tomorrow noon. nina: i'll add the aria snippets to the frame and comment on focus order. taylor: i'll mock the segmented actions and confirmation flows in storybook after final copy. maria: will review contrast and ensure tooltip copy is concise. designbot: deployment-slideout-review task created (#4321). reminders set for 48h. (reaction: :white_check_mark:) jamie: awesome — thanks everyone. leaving a small TODO in the Figma file: 'confirm type-to-confirm threshold for prod rollbacks (e.g., must type \"ROLLBACK\")'. kiran: one last tiny copy suggestion: confirmation dialog header -> 'Confirm rollback to previous release' (clear + consistent). maria: ok locking that in. thanks all :rocket:
